text.title: django-models Procedure
text.summary: Nine steps from ERD to validated models spec, ending at the migration gate.

step.name: extend-base
step.action: For each domain model: set extends ∈ {BaseModel, SoftDeletableModel, TenantAwareModel}.

step.name: declare-fields
step.action: For each field: name, type, choices_class if applicable. Mark is_pii at the model level.

step.name: declare-constraints
step.action: Add Meta.constraints entries: CheckConstraint for value ranges, UniqueConstraint for conditional uniqueness. Pin PostgreSQL when using partial conditions.

step.name: declare-indexes
step.action: For each field/combination used in filter()/order_by()/distinct() on production traffic: add db_index or a composite Meta.indexes entry. Justify in reason (≥ 10 chars).
step.decision-gate: Reject db_index=true with empty or short reason.

step.name: audit-on-delete
step.action: For each FK: choose on_delete explicitly with reason ≥ 10 chars. Default CASCADE on user/account refs is rejected.

step.name: declare-related-names
step.action: Give every FK and M2M an explicit `related_name`; use `"+"` where the reverse accessor is unwanted. Check for two FKs from different models to the same target.
step.decision-gate: An FK without related_name blocks — the clash surfaces as a makemigrations error naming unrelated apps (rule r14-related-name).

step.name: lay-out-the-models-package
step.action: An app with more than two models gets a `models/` package: one model per file, re-exported from `__init__.py`. `TextChoices` move to `constants.py` and are imported through a module alias.
step.output: File layout note in the spec consumer's plan.

step.name: wire-full-clean-and-validate
step.action: Set full_clean_in_service=true (this is a contract: every service that saves the model calls full_clean first). Emit spec; run scripts/validate-django-models.py.

step.name: gate-the-migration
step.input: The models the spec describes, now written.
step.action: Wire `templates/check-migrations.sh` into pre-commit so a model change without a staged migration fails. Read every generated migration — including squashed ones — for destructive operations (`RemoveField`, `AlterField` on a PK, a dropped constraint) before running `migrate`.
step.decision-gate: Never edit an applied migration; supersede it with a new one (rule r17-migration-hygiene).
